note: Example responses are real, from demo/ and evidence/ transcripts (v1) — not invented.

tools.name: omp_start
tools.desc: Spawn an isolated omp RPC session. The model goes in argv at spawn — an omp with no resolvable model can exit before `ready`, and nothing after spawn can fix a dead process.

tools.name: omp_send
tools.desc: Send a prompt. Synchronous by default: blocks up to timeout_ms (max 25 s) on the turn's own prompt_result. On timeout the status is running_or_unknown — the turn is never aborted and never re-sent.

example.message: Reply with exactly BRIDGE_E2E_OK and nothing else

tools.name: omp_steer
tools.desc: Redirect the agent mid-turn, on omp's native steer queue — the running task visibly changes direction without losing the turn.

example.message: Stop listing files — count only the Rust ones.

tools.name: omp_follow_up
tools.desc: Queue a message for after the current turn yields, on omp's follow-up queue.

example.message: Now summarize the result in one line.

tools.name: omp_take_control
tools.desc: Daemon mode: take the write lease for a shared session. Every reader sees an explicit bridge_control_transfer event — handoffs are visible, never silent.

tools.name: omp_events
tools.desc: Long-poll the session's ring buffer: {cursor, event} envelopes, bounded at 2048 entries / 2 MiB. A reader that fell behind sees an explicit dropped gap — never a silently truncated history.

tools.name: omp_status
tools.desc: Session state with distinct answers: running / settled / unknown. Missing data is reported as unknown, never fabricated. State payload is whitelisted — no command catalogs.

tools.name: omp_messages
tools.desc: The session transcript, paginated with a stable cursor — mapped on omp's paged history API.

tools.name: omp_set_model
tools.desc: Switch the live session to another model from the provider catalog.

tools.name: omp_compact
tools.desc: Trigger omp's context compaction for a long-running session.

tools.name: omp_abort
tools.desc: Abort the current turn; the session stays alive. The acknowledgement requests cancellation — it is not proof the agent settled, and the bridge says so.

tools.name: omp_stop
tools.desc: Tear down the whole omp process group. stopped: true only after a confirmed teardown — otherwise an honest error with a retrySafe hint.

tools.name: omp_list
tools.desc: Sessions owned by this bridge process (or this daemon, in shared mode).
